items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And I got to talking to him too one time and he said he was an engineer or in charge of recording in Camden, New Jersey.

ctx.x: But can you imagine — a Bessie Smith story direct. And then there was a guy, Jack Linderman was the head of — he was recording in Brazil, in Rio, for RCA. And I got to talking to him too one time and he said he was an engineer or in charge of recording in Camden, New Jersey. I said, “yeah?” I said, “you ever encounter Louis Armstrong?” He said, “yes, I was present at all those RCA Victor sessions.” You know?
